instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: 3D solid cantilever beam under an end concentrated force.

Model parameters:
- Beam cross section 10 mm x 10 mm, length 100 mm
- Material: Structural Steel
- Mesh: element size 5 mm

Boundary conditions and load:
- Fixed end: fully fixed
- Top midpoint of free end: concentrated force 100 N in the -Y direction

Analysis type: static structural analysis

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: wb_solid_beam.wbpj
- The auto-generated project directory must include solved results
